Bradish Chosen April's Best AL Hurler
A 5-0 record with a 1.32 ERA is a good month for most any pitcher. The American League thought it was worthy of an award and named <Kyle Bradish:player#24461>, starter for the <Baltimore Orioles:team#3>, April's Pitcher of the Month.

He also held the opposition to a .156 average while posting 39 strikeouts in 27.1 innings.
